displayAddress: Thomas Lane Apartments, Redcliff, Bristol, BS1
description:
This well-presented one bedroom apartment offers a comfortable and practical living space, ideal for those seeking a modern home in a convenient setting. The property benefits from a bright and welcoming interior, with wooden-effect flooring throughout and large windows allowing plenty of natural light into the accommodation.

The apartment features a spacious open-plan living area, with ample room for both relaxing and working from home, alongside a contemporary fitted kitchen with generous worktop space, plenty of storage and a range of integrated appliances, including a dishwasher, fridge, washing machine and oven/cooker. The double bedroom is well proportioned and benefits from large windows, creating a light and pleasant space. A private balcony provides valuable additional outdoor space, perfect for enjoying some fresh air or relaxing during warmer months.

This apartment would make an ideal home for a professional individual or couple looking for a well-located and comfortable property with the added benefit of private outdoor space and modern kitchen appliances. Offered unfurnished and available from the 1st September 2026.
